Body.Content:
Microsoft has published a new blog post outlining our response to the compromise of eMudhra intermediate certificate authority keys, including changes to the Windows and Microsoft Edge trust lists.

The Windows out-of-band updates are now available in the Microsoft Update Catalog. Administrators managing disconnected devices, or devices that don’t receive automatic certificate trust updates, can find more context and recommended steps in Microsoft’s response to compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys.

The following Windows updates are now available:

  • Windows 11, version 26H1: KB5134134
  • Windows 11, versions 26H2, 25H2, and 24H2: KB5134133
  • Windows 11, version 23H2: KB5134130
  • Windows Server 2025: KB5134137
  • Windows Server 2022: KB5134140
  • Windows 10, version 22H2 and Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2021: KB5134125
  • Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2019 and Windows Server 2019: KB5134124
  • Windows Server 2016: KB5134123

message.Title: New MSRC blog: Microsoft’s response to compromised eMudhra certificate authority keys
